models_evaluated: lightweight explainable anomaly detection model with spatiotemporal attention maps

links.outcome: Sensitivity and generalizability on internal 65-patient cohort versus later larger 90-patient cohort
links.effect: 65-patient cohort: 84.64±2.36% sensitivity, 92.16±2.33% generalizability at 7% max alert rate; 90-patient cohort: 77.04±1.35% sensitivity, 90.67±1.51% generalizability.
links.quote: In a larger 90-patient cohort (40,586 person-days; May 2022–Feb 2024), it achieved 77.04±1.35% sensitivity and 90.67±1.51% generalizability, a strong result given the inherent noise and variability of home sensor data.

unlisted_practices: household-personalized alert thresholds for anomaly detection
spatiotemporal attention maps for explainability of anomalies

screen.reason: The paper develops and retrospectively validates an AI anomaly detection and LLM summarization pipeline using real-world cohort data from dementia remote monitoring, but does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
